text:
It's a rather lonely
place, isn't it...?
People from Sapureth
like the moon
better than the sun.
That's why
most of them don't
go out during the day.
If I remember right, creatures
from Sapureth constantly use up
magic while they're in this world...
Moonlight is rich in mana,
so perhaps that makes
life easier for them?
If I remember right, creatures
from Sapureth constantly use up
magic while they're in this world...
Moonlight is rich in mana,
so perhaps that makes
life easier for them?
The Guardian here
is Mr. Armor.
You just met,
so there's no need
to visit again.
Mr. Armor
sits perfectly still
in a sparkly cave.
Maybe Mr. Armor
is a sleepyhead,
just like Mr. Stripes!
A sleepyhead...
But if you ask
Mr. Angel,
I'm sure it'll be all right!
Come on, let's go!
Hey, glad you came.
Sorry the place
is a mess.
Make yourself comfortable.
No, I'm the one
who should thank you
for inviting me.
It's just like
you heard from the others.
Keeping in touch with you...
Well, it's not something
I can't live with.
Yafha...
As far as I'm concerned,
as long as it doesn't turn into
a hassle, it's fine by me.
No need to try too hard.
Let's just take it easy.
Thank you,
Yafha.
Thank you,
Yafha.
We'll talk details
at the Gathering Spring...
Hey, Marurur!
That voice...
Hey, Marurur.
Is that the human
Mother and the others mentioned?
Ooh, Little Rascal!
It's rude to call someone
just 'human'!
Teacher's name is...
Um, the name...
Huh? Huh???
It's ●.
It's ●.
That's right!
Huh. What a weird name.
Little Rascal!
My name is Subaru.
Remember it already,
Marurur!
You're mean!
